title: Prague: Chronicle of a Hundred Spires
summary: From the 9th-century Přemyslid fortress of Prague Castle to the Gothic arches of Charles Bridge and the soaring vaults of St. Vitus Cathedral, journey through a millennium of Bohemian architecture.

fields.director_notes: Prompt: Adapt the multi-era diorama workflow (rome-through-time) to tell the epic architectural story of Prague across four monumental eras: Bohemian Seat (870 AD), Gothic Golden Age (1357 AD), Baroque Spires (1700 AD), and Modern Prague (2026 AD). MiniMax M3.1 Flash role: Authored bilingual storytelling scripts, directed cinematic camera passes over the Vltava River, Prague Castle, and Charles Bridge, paced lighting transitions, and scored narration timings. Audio: MiniMax Speech 2.8 HD English narration synchronized to historical milestones.
fields.my_city_line: A thousand years of stone and gold: Prague.
